question: Show district immunisation by year with year selector and district comparison; display source.

insights.message: Synthetic fixture data; no causal variables available to explain differences between districts.

view.title: District Immunisation Coverage by Year
view.note: coverage_percent shown as data label per bar (unit: percent). Subtracting two coverage_percent values yields percentage points, not percent growth.

interpretation_guard.caveat: Data is a deterministic synthetic smoke fixture. No causal mechanism is encoded; differences across districts or years must not be attributed to policy, funding, or access.
